recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No core FHIR follow-up is needed for FHIR-10763; future terminology maintenance should preserve the THO endpoint-payload-type any/none codes because the core value set imports that code system.
issue_request: FHIR-10763 asked for Endpoint.payloadFormat flexibility because the DSTU2 element appeared to be 1..1 despite use cases with no payload or multiple MIME types. The Published/Persuasive with Modification resolution chose to include example payload type codes for any content and no content.
initial_application: Commit 3e4dd26ef51c6ba90a3bcad1e3fb51e317ac05bb, titled 'Trackers# 12343, 10763, 12048', added the endpoint payload type code system include to source/endpoint/valueset-endpoint-payload-type.xml and updated the Endpoint spreadsheet. Published R3/R4 artifacts show the resulting any and none code definitions.
additional_context: Endpoint is active in source/fhir.ini. The current R6 source uses Endpoint.payload, Endpoint.payload.type, and Endpoint.payload.mimeType, all with 0..* cardinality, and the mimeType definition allows unspecified content including no content depending on connectionType. Later issues FHIR-34261, FHIR-20530, FHIR-28467, and FHIR-39617 changed cardinalities, value set imports, and explanatory payload advertising text without reversing the FHIR-10763 any/none concepts.
reconciliation: No source edit was needed. The current Endpoint definition already permits no declared payload/mime type where appropriate, and the current Endpoint payload type value set imports the THO endpoint-payload-type code system that still defines any and none.

related_jiras.note: Relaxed Endpoint.payload.type to 0..* in R5, reinforcing that the current resource no longer requires a declared payload type.
Required the Endpoint payload type value set to import format codes instead of duplicating them, explaining the current value set composition.
Paired with FHIR-20530 to use the proper FormatCodes value set while retaining the endpoint payload type code system.
Clarified current payload advertising semantics across payload.type, payload.mimeType, and profile without reversing the any/none concepts.
